summary: Spec fidelity: atip.cratecursor.13 says 'or a changed default is refused by both'; atip_cratecursor_13 adds role=member to a page that had none, which is the contract's 'an option added at its default value is another call in both' (the same case as atip_cratecursor_11), not a default that changed between two pages. The assertion is right; reword the scenario or add the changed-value case (role=member on page one, role=admin on page two).
